data.title: NH Investment & Securities Files KRW 62 Billion ELS Documents
data.description:
NH INVESTMENT & SECURITIES CO.LTD. ( (KR:005940) ) just unveiled an update.

NH Investment & Securities filed additional documents covering eight equity-linked securities series with a combined total amount offered or sold of KRW 62 billion. The disclosed series reference Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, KOSPI200, S&P500, NIKKEI225, Tesla and Advanced Micro Devices, with stepdown structures and maturities in November 2029.

Under the universal registration statement, the planned issuance amount was KRW 10 trillion, while total offerings or sales during the issuance period reached KRW 8.255 trillion and actual issuance amounted to KRW 2.943 trillion. The products are classified as high-risk investments, are not covered by depositor protection, and may result in losses of up to 100% of principal; the stated target market has high investment knowledge, loss tolerance and risk-seeking profiles.

data.title: Arika Resources Reports All AGM Resolutions Passed
data.description:
Metalicity Limited ( (AU:ARI) ) just unveiled an update.

Arika Resources Limited (ASX: ARI) reported that all resolutions considered at its 19 November 2026 annual general meeting passed by poll. Resolutions 3 and 4, covering approval of a section 7.1A mandate and insertion of proportional takeover provisions in the constitution, were approved as special resolutions.

Shareholders also approved the remuneration report and the re-election of director Steven Wood. The release provided voting results for each resolution, with all four resolutions recorded as carried.

data.title: Solaris Completes Dispatch of Entitlement Offer Documents
data.description:
An announcement from Solaris Australian Equity Income Plus Ltd. ( (AU:SET) ) is now available.

data.title: Adore Beauty reports all AGM resolutions passed
data.description:
Adore Beauty Group Ltd. ( (AU:ABY) ) has provided an announcement.

Adore Beauty Group is a beauty, lifestyle and wellness retailer operating in Australia and New Zealand, with an integrated omni-channel model combining its online platform and national retail-store network. The group includes Adore Beauty, an e-commerce destination, and iKOU, a wellness and beauty brand, offering more than 300 brands and 15,000 products.

At its 19 November 2026 annual general meeting, all resolutions passed by the requisite majority through a poll. The re-election of Lisa Hennessy and the remuneration report were both carried, receiving 99.79% and 99.26% support respectively in the poll.

data.title: momo.com Reports Suspected Cybersecurity Incident Involving mo Shop+ Shipment Data
data.description:
momo.com Incorporated ( (TW:8454) ) has provided an announcement.

momo.com Incorporated said it identified a suspected cybersecurity incident involving shipment data associated with its mo Shop+ service. A preliminary investigation found that certain shipment data was subject to unauthorized access, while member account passwords, credit card numbers and other payment-related information were not involved according to the investigation results currently available.

The company isolated affected systems, strengthened monitoring and access controls, and reported the incident to relevant authorities. Major operating systems and e-commerce services continue to function normally, and the company said the incident currently has no material impact on operations or financial condition.

data.title: LCI Stockholders Approve Merger Proposal, Pending Regulatory Approval
data.description:
LCI Industries ( (LCII) ) has shared an announcement.

LCI Industries, through its Lippert subsidiary, supplies engineered components to the outdoor recreation and transportation markets, serving original-equipment manufacturers and aftermarket customers. The company focuses on engineered solutions for outdoor recreation and transportation applications.

On November 18, 2026, LCI stockholders approved the merger proposal by 20,049,918 votes to 480,909, with 29,006 abstentions, while an advisory proposal on merger-related executive compensation was not approved. Patrick shareholders also approved the proposals needed for the transaction, and the companies said the merger remained subject to required regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.
